defect.description: The new condition is not valid Python: `!` is not a negation operator (it should be `not hmac.compare_digest(...)`), so src/auth.py raises SyntaxError on import and every caller and test of is_authorized breaks.

review_items: Short-circuit `or` skips the password comparison when the username mismatches, leaking username validity via timing
Parenthesised `if (!hmac.compare_digest(...) or !hmac.compare_digest(...))` is unconventional; prefer `not`/positive `return a and b`
Comment about constant-time comparison restates the obvious; remove it or explain why
votes.evidence_quote: Minor: the parenthesised `if (!hmac.compare_digest(...) or !hmac.compare_digest(...)):` is unconventional.
votes.justification: The review quotes the exact faulty `!hmac.compare_digest` condition in is_authorized but calls it only an unconventional readability issue. It never says `!` is invalid Python or that the module fails to import with a SyntaxError.
